research_evidence.imagegen_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: original vertical Pinterest base image for an AI product photography prompt. Create a polished diptych with two distinct photographic setups of the same invented unbranded amber perfume bottle, identical hexagonal silhouette and black cap: left panel a restrained ivory catalog still life with soft diffuse studio light, right panel a warm editorial advertising still life with strong diagonal afternoon sunlight and a single curling ribbon of orange peel. Separate the panels with a subtle narrow gutter; vary the camera angle and scale between panels. Premium realistic glass, believable reflections, crisp object edges. Keep the upper and middle two thirds visually interesting and leave the lower quarter less detailed for an editorial text overlay. No people, no existing brands, no labels, no logos, no words, no watermark. Do not reproduce any Pinterest source image.
